先看启动页日志和版本设置里的崩溃分析。常见原因是 Java 版本不对、内存不够、: Check teh launch log and teh crash analysis in version settings. Common causes r teh wrong Java, too little RAM, or a mod conflict. Turn on automatic memory, or pick Java in version settings.

可以用中文名搜，例如「钠」「小地图」。搜索用的是真实 Minecraft 版本号: U can search by Chinese name, for example Sodium or minimap. Search uses teh real Minecraft version, even if u renamed teh instance. Dependencies like Fabric API and Cloth Config r installed when possible. BMCLAPI iz usually faster.

需要 JIT。用 StikDebug / SideStore / TrollSt: JIT iz required. Use StikDebug / SideStore / TrollStore, or turn on built-in JIT in settings (experimental). 26.3 and newer cannot launch yet.
